_note: terrain_pilot 시범 명세(README.md 대신 JSON: 안아트 규칙상 문서 파일 대신 명세 데이터 파일). 앱 미적용·커밋 없음.

current_engine.autotile: 47 blob, bits N1 NE2 E4 SE8 S16 SW32 W64 NW128, diagonal only if both orthogonals
current_engine.terrain_symbols: p plain, f forest, m mountain, w water, s shallows, r road, d sand, k cliff, x swamp, n snow_desert, v village, c castle, b bridge, W wall (U32_SYMBOL)

light: upper-left, shadows lower-right; sprites must NOT be h-flipped

base_textures.rule: 32px periodic; v1/v2 share the outer 3px band with v0 -> any variant next to any variant is seamless; suggested weights v0 50%, v1 25%, v2 25%

autotile47.sheet_layout: 8 cols x 6 rows, slot i = masks_order[i] (47 used, last slot empty)

sets.grass_water: w next to grass (dark rock bank + foam)
sets.sand_water: w next to sand (foam + shallow band)
sets.grass_sand: d (neighbor d or w counts as same)
sets.cliff_grass: plateau cell; south edge = 14px rock face

autotile47.mask_bits_for_cell: bit set if neighbour is the same group (see sample_map.py); out-of-map counts as same

objects.anchor: bottom-center, draw after ground, y-sorted with units
objects.forest_rule: 5 small pines per f cell at offsets (6,12),(20,10),(13,22),(27,24),(3,30) +-2px
objects.mountain_rule: 1 peak per m cell, peak_a_l 45%, x jitter +-6px

qa.skill_qa_report: qa/qa_*.json: HARD-FAIL on palette_fidelity (custom palette, not db32) and tile_seam_diff (47-blob tiles are not self-tiling by design) -> gates not applicable

tools.build: python tools/build_textures.py && python tools/autotile.py && python tools/build_objects.py && python tools/sample_map.py && python tools/compare.py
tools.deps: numpy, Pillow, scipy, rembg 2.0.87 (MIT, PyPI; local bg removal, model weights auto-downloaded by package)

known_gaps: mixed shore (water cell touching both grass and sand) shows a hard straight cut
cliff plateau reads weakly (no height shading, 14px face only on south)
mountains are stamped single peaks, not merged massifs
dirt road texture repeats visibly every cell
edges follow the grid (stair-steps) more than the reference
